questions.subject: Japanese
questions.prompt: What is the Japanese word for the number 60?

block.label: Scrub It
block.sub: Rub out the wrong answers with your finger

questions.why: 60 is rokujuu (roku + juu, 'six tens'). Nanajuu is 70, hachijuu is 80, and kyuujuu is 90.

questions.subject: History
questions.prompt: Order these roles in Japan's feudal system by how much contact they had with the emperor, from most to least
questions.why: The emperor dealt directly with the shogun, who ruled in his name; daimyo answered to the shogun, while peasants had almost no direct contact with the emperor at all.
